# 👀 Code Review

## Change summary
What does the contribution change and why?

## Correctness
- [ ] Behavior matches the stated objective.
- [ ] Boundary conditions considered.
- [ ] Loops terminate.
- [ ] No unrelated changes.

## Maintainability
- [ ] Beginner-readable examples.
- [ ] Consistent formatting.
- [ ] No unnecessary dependencies.

## Quality
- [ ] Structural validation result reviewed.
- [ ] Browser behavior checked.
- [ ] Asset paths verified.
- [ ] Documentation updated.

## Security and accessibility
- [ ] No secrets or unsafe dynamic execution.
- [ ] Semantic markup and image alternatives considered.

## Review decision
Approve / Request changes / Comment, with evidence.
